title: Why Your Carousel Dies On Slide Two

caption.text:
If your carousel gets impressions but not saves, the problem is almost never the hook.

It is slide two. Instagram will happily re-serve your post starting at frame two, and if that frame introduces a topic instead of raising a stake, the reader is gone.

Diagnostic:
1. Does frame two make sense alone?
2. Does it raise a question or answer one?
3. Is there a reason to keep swiping?

Three yes answers, or rewrite the frame.

slides.headline: Frame two introduces. It should raise a stake.
slides.alt_text: Reveal slide with a teaser card bleeding off the right edge.
slides.body: A frame that sets context — "here is some background" — asks the reader to invest before giving them a reason. The next slide has to pay that investment back instantly.

slides.verdict: Every frame should be able to open the deck.
